dependency_reason: Shows how a gzip stream acquires the custom header that a later reset could clear.
Gzip wrapping requires the distinct windowBits configuration.
Installing the custom header requires a gzip-wrapped stream.
A cleared gzhead selects default gzip header emission.
The decompression half initializes and synchronizes the stream produced by the default compression path.
The complete entry supplies bytes to one compression and synchronization sequence.
The target calls deflateInit with the default compression level, so this compression path supplies no gzip windowBits configuration.
